note: Phase 3 mapping and coverage statistics from the Daily Drilling Reports. Not prices, not findings; no invoice data was read.

switches.name: appendix_g_reading

readings.description: Literal: the table is the contract's vocabulary and governs as printed.
The LWD rows are shifted by one line and the words carry their ordinary meaning.

switches.explanation: Which LWD service a logging-tool word evidences. The shifted reading moves the three LWD 'logged' rows (and LH-714, which follows LW-410) up one row; the other surprising pairings have no alternative in the contract and stay literal.

switches.name: appendix_g_duplicates

readings.description: The rental/logging code applies while the tool is in the hole; the LH code applies to a tool recorded as lost (Part E).
The term alone cannot identify the item; such charges are unresolved identification (guideline check 6).

switches.explanation: A term listed for a rental and a lost-in-hole code: the Appendix G footnote says Part E context selects the lost-in-hole row.

switches.name: dd102_basis

readings.description: Per coordinator the report records (the 'night man' crew count), limit 1 a day.
Each day the report records a tool in the hole.

switches.explanation: What evidences DD-102: the coordinator the report records (Appendix G 'night man'), or any day a tool is in the hole.

switches.name: hc630_basis

readings.description: Count clean-out runs from the report for an Operating day (Clause 30).
Once per BHA run.

switches.explanation: HC-630 from the daily clean-out-run count (cl. 30) or once per BHA run (Schedule 8).

switches.name: dd121_condition

readings.description: Only on a Standby day on which the report records the rotary steerable in the hole.
On every Standby day of a well using the rotary steerable, in place of DD-120.

switches.explanation: Which Standby days evidence DD-121.

switches.name: dd120_hours

readings.description: Circulating hours only (Clause 21).
Circulating plus back-reaming hours (Schedule 8).

switches.explanation: Which recorded hours evidence DD-120.

switches.name: metre_source

readings.description: Day metres: depth end minus depth start on an Operating day with the tool in the hole.
Part B metres logged/reamed.

switches.explanation: LW-410/411/412 and RM-510 metres from the day's depth advance, or once per run from Part B metres logged/reamed.

switches.name: lih_hours

readings.description: Use the Part E figure as stated.
Use the tool's own hours on the well (sum of report hours while that tool was in the hole, including the day of loss).

switches.explanation: Depreciation hours for a lost tool: the Part E figure or the tool's own daily hours on the well. Both values are carried; depreciation itself is Phase 4.

switches.name: report_vocabulary

readings.description: Rig words are the contractual form; Appendix G maps them to codes.
The report must list codes (R5/R6); a report in rig words is non-compliant.

switches.explanation: Whether a report written in rig words (not service codes) is compliant. Phase 3 reads the rig words either way.

switches.name: rig_up_hour

readings.description: Deduct one hour per report day for each hourly service, then apply the 6-hour minimum.
Deduct one hour per BHA run (first day of the run only).
No deduction: charge the circulating hours recorded, as Appendix B does.
Apply the 6-hour minimum first, then deduct the rig-up hour.

switches.explanation: 21A rig-up hour and the 6-hour minimum on DD-120 and RM-530. Used later in the pricing phase; Phase 3 carries recorded hours.

switches.name: pd210_class_factor

readings.description: Apply the Schedule 3 Part 2 class factor to PD-210.
Do not apply the class factor to PD-210.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: standby_section_factor

readings.description: On a Standby day apply section factor, class factor, then standby percentage (Clause 18 order, no exception).
On a Standby day omit the section factor; apply class factor and standby percentage.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: rig_services_index

readings.description: Apply the index from the first month (17A, Schedule 2C); Appendix B illustrates the build-up only.
Appendix B, a Clause 2 contract document, shows MW-310 charged without the index; the index does not apply (or not in 2025).

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: dd120_rate_from_feb_2026

readings.description: Later issued governs: A3's 416.00 applies to all DD-120 services from 2026-02-01, displacing the S2 monthly table.
Later effective governs: 416.00 for February and March 2026; the S2 monthly rates from April 2026.
A3 substitutes the Schedule 1 rate only; the monthly re-publication is a separate mechanism and governs from April 2026 regardless.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: monthly_rate_basis

readings.description: The monthly rate replaces the Schedule 1 base rate; the Clause 18 build-up and discounts still apply.
The monthly 'rate chargeable' is the final rate; no factors are applied to it.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: principal_discount_combination

readings.description: 7% replaces 4% from 2026-07-01.
Both apply from 2026-07-01 (cumulative).

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: volume_tier_scope

readings.description: Per well: cumulative metres already drilled on that well within the Contract Year.
Contract-wide: cumulative metres across all wells within the Contract Year.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: contract_year_2

readings.description: Contract Year 2 runs 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 (starts at the anniversary; ends on the extended Expiry Date).
The extensions do not begin a new Contract Year, so Contract Year 1 continues to 2026-12-31.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: lih_replacement_value

readings.description: Schedule 2D converted at the month of loss (31A).
Schedule 6 USD values (Clause 31).

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: ds900_threshold_basis

readings.description: Services only (Schedule 1 items including LH items); the 36A adjustment is excluded.
Every charge on the invoice other than DS-900 itself.

switches.explanation: Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: unranked_precedence

readings.description: The unlisted documents form part of the contract but have no stated rank; each conflict must be resolved on its own terms (specific over general, or kept as a sensitivity switch).
Rank by name: Schedules 2C, 2D, 7 and 8 are Schedules and prevail over any Part (Clause 2); Part IX, being 'Particular Conditions (Second Series)', ranks with Part VI and prevails over Parts I-V.
Clause 2 is exhaustive: documents it does not list are not contract documents and carry no weight against listed ones.

switches.explanation: Meta-switch: how conflicts involving unlisted documents are settled. Used later in the pricing phase.

switches.name: backdated_adjustment

readings.description: One adjustment for the whole contract, on the first invoice (any well) submitted on or after 2026-08-17 (36A wording).
As A but strictly after 2026-08-17 (A3 wording).
One adjustment per well, on that well's first invoice submitted on or after the date of issue.
No re-pricing of services already charged (Schedule of Variations).

switches.explanation: Used later when invoices are compared; no report evidence depends on it.

switches.name: calloff_evidence

readings.description: Take the well class stated on the invoice header as the Contractor's statement of the call-off, unverified; treat PD-210 as eligible only in 12-1/4 or 8-1/2 inch sections (the only sizes Appendix A allows).
Treat both as unverifiable: charges that depend on them are queries, not verified passes.

switches.explanation: Well class and performance-section eligibility without call-offs. Phase 3 marks the condition as unknown.

switches.name: record_signatories

readings.description: Schedule 5 governs: Parts B-E of the signed DDR are the records; the DDR's two signatures (cl. 15) cover them.
Each record needs the signatories of its illustrative form (Appendices E-F).

switches.explanation: Used later when invoices are compared.

switches.name: missing_record_consequence

readings.description: Not payable: part-reject the charge.
Payable later once delivered: a query, not a rejection.

switches.explanation: Used later when invoices are compared.

switches.name: submission_date

readings.description: Treat the invoice date as the submission date.
Submission date unknown: window findings are queries.

switches.explanation: Used later when invoices are compared.

evidence_facts.fact: Runs whose tools include 'gamma tool' (literal LW-410) and runs with Part B metres logged > 0.
Runs whose tools include 'resistivity tool' (literal LW-411 density and neutron) and runs carrying a radioactive source (T9: density and neutron need one).
Runs whose tools include 'hole opener' (RM-511, the underreamer of cl. 25) and runs with metres reamed > 0.
Days with 'logging engineers' on tour, and days with any literal LWD tool word in the hole.
Hole sections on days with 'performance engineer' on tour (performance-drilled sections are nominated in call-offs, which are not provided).
Standby days: circulating hours are still recorded on some; the rotary steerable is in the hole on some.
Records named by Schedule 5 that are absent on a day they apply (structural; consequence undecided).
